subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw support non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup, and which handoff is acceptable: callback URL import, token import/app-server chatgptAuthTokens bridge, or no new automation surface for now?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but choosing how OAuth material enters automation affects credential exposure, refresh ownership, provider routing, logs, and the supported setup contract.

options.title: Design provider-owned handoff
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a narrow OpenAI-owned callback or token import contract with PKCE/state validation, redaction, docs, and security-focused tests.

options.title: Accept callback URL env
options.body: Implement the requested env-style callback URL import directly with strict validation and explicit documentation, accepting the additional exposure risk as product policy.

options.title: Defer to current flows
options.body: Keep browser OAuth, device-code login, and API-key setup as the supported automation surfaces until upstream or product direction provides a safer external-auth contract.

recommendation.title: Design provider-owned handoff
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a narrow OpenAI-owned callback or token import contract with PKCE/state validation, redaction, docs, and security-focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans non-interactive provider setup, OpenAI provider ownership, and auth/security product policy, all areas tied to this person's feature history.
